content.comment_body: How can I set up communication between [product_name] software version [version_no] and an online [product_name] PLC built on [article_no] to upload a program? To transfer or load a program from or to [product_name], you need a special cable. There are imitation cables from China, but I don't recommend them. Two types are available: one for PC with RS232 interface ([article_no]), and another for PC with USB interface ([article_no]). Programs from earlier models ([article_no] to [article_no]) can be upgraded to [version_no]; just select the newer hardware version in your device settings.

The demo version cannot communicate with [product_name]—it is only for learning, program creation, and simulation. To transfer data, you need the full version of [product_name]. Demo versions cannot be upgraded to full versions.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users want to connect a PC to a [product_name] PLC ([article_no]) to upload and back up an existing application using [product_name] ([version_no]). There is uncertainty about compatibility between software and hardware versions, as well as concerns about possible data corruption. The inability to communicate with the PLC using the demo software is a significant limitation.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to reliably upload a program from a [product_name] PLC ([article_no]) using the full version of [product_name] ([version_no]), ensuring all data is retained and no compatibility issues or corruption occur due to different software or hardware versions.
